text: dsh-arxiv-search 是面向 DSH web 客户端的 arXiv 论文搜索工具插件，通过注册 arxiv_search 工具接收搜索词和结果数量、排序方式，并查询 arXiv API。它解析论文标题、作者、摘要、日期、分类、摘要页和 PDF 链接，供模型展示为可读结果。适合查找研究论文、浏览近期预印本或整理阅读清单。无需 API Key；搜索查询会发送到 export.arxiv.org。

dsh-arxiv-search adds an arXiv search tool to DSH web. It accepts a query, result limit and sort order, then returns paper titles, authors, abstracts, dates, categories and links. Use it to find research papers or browse preprints. No API key is required; queries are sent to export.arxiv.org.
帮我查找 arXiv 上关于某个研究主题的论文。
想按提交或更新时间排序浏览相关预印本。
Find recent arXiv papers on a research topic and get their abstracts and links.
dsh-arxiv-search 的功能「搜索论文」：调用 arxiv_search 按查询词获取论文，可设数量（默认 10，最多 200）及相关度、提交时间或更新时间排序。结果包含标题、作者、摘要和链接。
dsh-arxiv-search 的功能「解析并呈现论文元数据」：搜索结果会被解析为结构化论文信息，包含 arXiv ID、标题、作者、摘要、发表和更新时间、分类、摘要页链接及可用的 PDF 链接，并以文本形式呈现。

dsh-arxiv-search README · dsh-arxiv-search：arXiv search tool plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). Registers one model-facing tool, `arxiv_search`, that queries the public [arXiv API](https://export.arxiv.org/api/query) and returns structured paper metadata — no API key, no Python dependency, no client bundle.

Originally adapted from the [arxiv-search skill](https://github.com/aiskillstore/marketplace/tree/main/skills/dougtrajano/arxiv-search) (MIT, aiskillstore marketplace).

dsh-arxiv-search README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/<your-account>/dsh-arxiv-search/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz
```

Then restart the web server (`dsh web`) so the Host loads the new plugin. In any new conversation the model can call the `arxiv_search` tool directly.

dsh-arxiv-search README · Usage：Just ask in natural language, e.g.:

- "搜一下 2024 年后的 uplift modeling 论文"
- "Find recent papers about diffusion models, 5 results"
- "按提交时间排序搜 protein folding"

Tool arguments:

| Arg | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string (required) | Search query, e.g. `"uplift modeling"` |
| `maxPapers` | number | Max results (default 10, capped 200) |
| `sortBy` | string | `relevance` \| `submittedDate` \| `updatedDate` (default relevance) |
dsh-arxiv-search README · Usage：Each result includes title, authors, abstract, dates, categories, abs URL, and PDF link.

dsh-arxiv-search README · Uninstall：Remove the dependency from `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/package.json` (and from `dsh.profile.bundles`), run `pnpm install` in that directory, then restart the web server.

dsh-arxiv-search README · Development：Plain ESM JavaScript, no build step — `lib/` is the source of truth and ships as-is. To test the search logic standalone:

```sh
node --input-type=module -e "import { searchArxiv } from './lib/index.js'; console.log(await searchArxiv({ query: 'uplift modeling', maxPapers: 3 }))"
```
